samaveda_hymn9.title: Meditation on Om
samaveda_hymn9.description: The Samaveda tradition places special emphasis on the meditation upon the sacred syllable Om as the Udgitha or supreme chant.

samaveda_hymn9.introduction: The Samaveda tradition places special emphasis on the meditation upon the sacred syllable Om as the Udgitha or supreme chant.
samaveda_hymn9.scripture_text: A representative Samavedic hymn passage for Hymn 9, expressing melodic devotion, sacred recitation, and meditative harmony.
samaveda_hymn9.philosophical_explanation: Om represents the convergence of music, language and spiritual truth. Through devoted meditation on this sacred sound, the practitioner can transcend the limitations of ordinary consciousness and realize the unity of the individual self with the universal reality.
